sections.text: New to kung fu? Your first class is always free — no experience or equipment needed.

cards.heading: All Skill Levels Welcome
cards.text: From first-timers to advanced students, every class is taught in traditional Hung Gar lineage.

cards.heading: Community, Not a Franchise
cards.text: We're a registered non-profit — every dollar goes back into the school and our lion dance troupe.

cards.heading: Real Performance Experience
cards.text: Students who want to perform can join the lion dance troupe for real community events.

cards.heading: Kung Fu Classes
cards.text: Traditional Hung Gar forms, conditioning, and sparring for youth and adults.

cards.heading: Lion Dance Troupe
cards.text: Performances for Chinese New Year, grand openings, weddings, and corporate events.

cards.heading: Community Events
cards.text: Workshops, demonstrations, and youth programs throughout the year.

sections.heading: Three Pillars: Discipline, Community, Tradition
sections.text: Shaolin Hung Gar Kung Fu is a non-profit school dedicated to preserving Southern Shaolin martial arts and lion dance culture in Vancouver. Every class is rooted in the lineage passed down from our sifu, with an emphasis on discipline, respect, and community.

members.name: Sifu (Head Instructor)
members.bio: Trained in traditional Hung Gar lineage, teaching in Vancouver for over a decade.

members.name: Assistant Instructor
members.bio: Leads youth classes and lion dance drum training.

members.name: Lion Dance Captain
members.bio: Coordinates performances and trains the lion dance troupe.

members.name: Youth Program Lead
members.bio: Runs our beginner and youth kung fu programs.

sections.heading: Bring the Lion Dance to Your Next Event
sections.text: Grand openings, weddings, Chinese New Year celebrations, and corporate events.

sections.quote: My daughter has grown so much in confidence since joining. The instructors treat every student like family.
